article_title: Neoclouds: These firms you've never heard of are feeding fears the AI bubble could burst

tasks.prompt: What concern does the article raise about neocloud companies?
options: They refuse to provide computing power to major AI developers.
Their debt-heavy business models could be vulnerable if AI spending slows or the AI boom collapses.
They have replaced every large technology company in the data-centre market.
Their only customers are cryptocurrency miners.
tasks.correct_answer: Their debt-heavy business models could be vulnerable if AI spending slows or the AI boom collapses.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד חוב גבוה ותלות בלקוחות AI גדולים הופכים את חברות הנאוקלאוד לפגיעות אם ההשקעות יואטו או הבועה תתפוצץ.

tasks.prompt: What is a “neocloud” in the context of the article?
options: A government agency that regulates artificial intelligence
A cryptocurrency issued by a data-centre operator
A company that operates computer-packed data centres and leases computing capacity to AI developers
A social network for technology investors
tasks.correct_answer: A company that operates computer-packed data centres and leases computing capacity to AI developers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: נאוקלאוד היא חברה שמפעילה מרכזי נתונים עמוסים במחשבים יקרים ומשכירה כוח מחשוב למפתחי AI גדולים.

tasks.prompt: How do neocloud firms often obtain loans?
options: They pledge long-term customer contracts and purchased AI chips as collateral.
They sell all their data centres to governments.
They borrow only from their own employees.
They guarantee loans with future cryptocurrency prices.
tasks.correct_answer: They pledge long-term customer contracts and purchased AI chips as collateral.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברות משתמשות בחוזי שכירות ארוכי טווח עם לקוחות ובשבבי ה־AI שרכשו כבטוחות להלוואות.

tasks.prompt: Which figure illustrates CoreWeave's financial risk?
options: It employs 80% of Silicon Valley.
It owns every AI chip made in 2026.
It has no long-term customers.
It accumulated $35.1bn in debt.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת ש־CoreWeave צברה חוב של 35.1 מיליארד דולר, סכום שממחיש את המינוף הגבוה במודל העסקי.

tasks.prompt: Why did lower-than-expected AI spending forecasts from Microsoft and Google hurt neocloud shares?
options: Neoclouds are legally required to match Big Tech's advertising budgets.
Their revenue prospects depend heavily on large customers continuing to demand computing capacity.
The forecasts banned neoclouds from purchasing chips.
Microsoft and Google announced that data centres were no longer needed.
tasks.correct_answer: Their revenue prospects depend heavily on large customers continuing to demand computing capacity.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנאוקלאודים תלויים בהמשך הביקוש של לקוחות ענק; תחזית הוצאה נמוכה יותר מאותתת שהביקוש העתידי עלול להיחלש.

tasks.prompt: What does “collateral damage” mean when the article discusses a possible AI-bubble collapse?
options: Physical damage to chips used as loan security
A planned reduction in electricity consumption
Secondary harm suffered because of a wider crisis
Profits earned from selling collateral
tasks.correct_answer: Secondary harm suffered because of a wider crisis
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאן collateral damage מתייחס לנזק משני: גם אם הנאוקלאודים אינם גורם הקריסה, הם ייפגעו ממנה בשל תלותם בכלכלת ה־AI.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the crypto-mining origins of several neocloud firms helped them enter the AI market.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את התשתית המשותפת ואת השינוי בביקוש לאחר הופעת ChatGPT.
expected_points: Crypto miners already operated expensive computing and data-centre infrastructure.
AI development requires similar physical infrastructure and chips.
When generative AI demand surged after ChatGPT appeared in 2022, firms such as CoreWeave, IREN, Core Scientific and Applied Digital were well positioned to switch or expand.

tasks.prompt: Why can strong current demand coexist with fears about the neocloud sector's future?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את המתח בין ביקוש נוכחי גבוה לבין סיכונים פיננסיים ותפעוליים עתידיים, עם שתי ראיות לפחות.
expected_points: Demand for computing power currently exceeds supply, so neoclouds fill an important gap.
Expansion requires expensive hardware paid for up front and large amounts of borrowing.
Higher interest rates make refinancing more costly.
A slowdown by Big Tech or AI developers could reduce revenue while debts remain.
Power constraints, cancelled deals and delayed public offerings show operational and market risks.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the neocloud business model, its recent success and its main vulnerabilities in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול לקוחות, מימון, מקורות התעשייה, סיבת הצמיחה ושלושה סיכונים מרכזיים.
expected_points: Neoclouds lease specialised computing capacity to major AI developers and hyperscalers.
They often finance costly hardware with debt secured by contracts and chips.
Some grew from crypto-mining infrastructure and benefited from the post-2022 AI surge.
Their risks include heavy debt, higher interest rates and dependence on customer spending.
A wider AI downturn, power shortages or consolidation could leave smaller firms especially exposed.

tasks.prompt: Write a short investor risk note evaluating whether recent neocloud problems are evidence of a wider AI bubble.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טענה מאוזנת, להשתמש בראיות בעד ונגד מהכתבה ולהבדיל בין סיכון ענפי לבין הוכחה לקריסת כל תחום ה־AI.
expected_points: Cite warning signs such as falling share prices, rising debt yields, CoreWeave's debt, cancelled deals or shelved IPO plans.
Note Gartner and Forrester predictions about consolidation or loss of independence.
Balance these against demand for computing power still exceeding supply and major customers seeking infrastructure.
Conclude cautiously that neocloud weakness may reveal financial fragility but does not by itself prove the whole AI economy is a bubble.
